jamie: Quick update from the KV compactness run (shadow vs prod) — ran FP8 and INT8 on KV-only paths across 5k eval prompts. wanted to capture raw numbers and quick hypotheses.

jamie: TL;DR: ~22% KV memory reduction (FP8), ~28% (INT8); p50 nearly same, p95 cold-start +35-60ms on INT8, occasional quality deltas on long-prefix prompts (EM drop ~0.6% absolute on our synthetic QA set). :thinking_face:

sasha: can you paste the perf log and the exact command you used?

jamie: command: `./run_kv_quant_bench.sh --model oak-13b --kv-only --modes fp8,int8 --seed 42 --shadow=true --batch-dist=varying`

jamie: sample perf snippet:
```
mode=fp8 kv_mem_bytes=1.9GB baseline_kv=2.45GB mem_delta=-22.4% p50=28ms p95=110ms p99=220ms cold_start_p95=150ms
mode=int8 kv_mem_bytes=1.77GB baseline_kv=2.45GB mem_delta=-27.9% p50=30ms p95=145ms p99=320ms cold_start_p95=210ms
quality_em_baseline=82.3% quality_em_fp8=81.8% quality_em_int8=81.7%
error_rate_long_prefix_baseline=0.9% error_rate_long_prefix_int8=1.6%
```

rohit: interesting. mem savings are great for INT8. the cold_start p95 jump is worrying. do we know if it's kernel-induced (dequant on hotpath) or memory bandwidth?

jamie: traced stack on a repro where p95 spikes. looks like dequant + KV deserialization on cold fills adds ~30-50ms for INT8. FP8 path uses fused dequant + mv kernel so cheaper.

maria: did you try hybrid mode (FP8 for attention KV, INT8 for projection storage) ? might keep decode latency low while saving more memory.

jamie: not yet. i did a quick config: `kv_quant_config: { attention: fp8, projection: int8 }` and ran a 200-sample micro-run — promising: p95 cold ~120ms, mem_delta ~-25%. quality same as FP8. will run full shadow tonight.

sasha: for the quality deltas on long prefixes, can you attach an example prompt where INT8 drops EM? might be a precision-sensitive accumulation bug.

jamie: pasted one failing prompt in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/kv-int8-longprefix-01 (contains model outputs baseline vs int8). gist shows small but meaningful difference in answer tokens at the KV read stage.

rohit: might be related to KV key normalization / small rounding drift accumulating during many steps. we should instrument per-step cosine similarity of KV reads between baseline and quant run.

maria: agree. also try toggling per-channel scaling vs per-tensor for KV quant tables. per-channel may reduce drift at cost of storage for scales.

jamie: scheduled runs: full shadow FP8 (complete), INT8 (in progress), hybrid (queued). CI job kicked off: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/kv-quant-shadow/1729999999 :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: CI started: kv-quant-shadow/1729999999 on oak-13b (FP8/INT8/hybrid). logs will be at /ci/artifacts/kv-quant-shadow/1729999999/

sasha: next steps: (1) run per-step KV similarity traces, (2) microprofile dequant kernel to confirm hotspot, (3) trial per-channel scales for KV, (4) gather the long-prefix error cases and create small eval slices. i'll own (1) and (4). rohit will own (2). jamie do full hybrid run.

rohit: i can add a quick kernel microbench and a dequant-only timing hook by EOD. if dequant is >25% of cold extra, we should consider fused path for int8 or keeping fp8 for the dequant hotpath.

jamie: thanks. will post results in this thread after the hybrid shadow completes. if hybrid holds, proposal: use hybrid on Dedicated by default and INT8 only for cold-storage tiers.

maria: sounds good. adding to the roadmap notes for kv-quant options and deployment profiles. :thumbsup:

jamie: one more note: observed a small increase in token-level hallucination on very long prompts under INT8 (+0.2% halluc token rate). probably same drift source. ok stopping here for now.
